title: How to improve the client intake process for paralegals on Mac in 2026
metaTitle: Improve Client Intake Process for Paralegals on Mac
description: Learn how to fix your client intake process on your Mac to save time, reduce errors, and stop losing billable hours.
intro: The client intake process is a high-friction stage that often acts as a major operational bottleneck for law firms. Paralegals frequently lose hours each week manually re-entering data across disconnected systems, which delays the start of billable work and contributes to significant administrative burnout.
tldr: Law firms take an average of 24 days to onboard a new client.
Manual data entry errors are a primary cause of onboarding delays.
Firms lose an average of 1.5 billable hours per matter due to setup delays.
Standardizing workflows can reduce onboarding time by 50 percent.
Centralizing your Mac workspace helps you manage intake without constant context switching.

blocks.text: Why your client intake process is stalling

The problem is rarely the lack of software. It is the fragmentation of data across your Mac. You likely use Outlook for email, Excel for tracking, and various local PDF forms. This patchwork of disconnected applications forces you to manually type the same information multiple times. This is prone to human error and creates communication black holes. Clients are left wondering about the status of their matter while you hunt for the latest version of a document.
The real cost of onboarding friction

For a firm opening 15 matters per month, delays in billing setup can equal $94,500 in unbilled work annually. Beyond the money, there is the human cost. Repetitive administrative tasks are a primary driver of paralegal turnover. Replacing a skilled paralegal costs a firm between $30,000 and $60,000. When knowledge lives only in the heads of senior staff, every new hire requires months of training just to learn how to navigate your firm's specific intake quirks.

items: Map your workflow: Move from tribal knowledge to a written, visible process. Define clear stages like Intake Form Pending and Retainer Pending.
Digitize your forms: Replace paper or PDF forms with digital intake forms that feed data directly into your practice management system.
Automate handoffs: Use tools that trigger the next step, such as a conflict check, as soon as you complete the previous task.
Set clear expectations: Provide clients with transparent, jargon-free timelines early in the process.

blocks.text: Using your Mac for legal onboarding

Mac users often face challenges with legacy software that lacks native macOS integration. You need tools that work well with Finder and your daily workflow. Clio and MyCase provide cloud-based management with Finder integration. Daylite is a native Mac app that links email, documents, and tasks directly in macOS. For document review, PDF Expert remains a standard for marking up contracts and discovery materials.

Lazur acts as a voice assistant for your Mac. It helps you manage the intake process by answering questions about your screen and guiding you through complex interfaces. You can hold ⌥ ⌘ to ask about a specific field in your case management software. Lazur will answer out loud, helping you stay focused on the client rather than the software.

faq.question: How can I reduce manual data entry during intake?
faq.answer: Use digital intake forms that sync directly with your practice management software. Avoid PDF forms that require manual re-typing.

faq.question: Is it safe to use AI assistants for client data?
faq.answer: Always follow your employer rules on client data. Lazur does not store your screen or audio data, but ensure you are compliant with your firm's internal security policies before using any new software.

faq.question: What is the biggest cause of onboarding delays?
faq.answer: Data fragmentation is the biggest cause. When information is split across disconnected apps like Outlook, Excel, and local drives, staff spend too much time searching for and re-entering data.
